artifacts/core/replay/shards/ is gitignored and absent, so for the core arm the per-episode episodes.csv is the lowest-level file available; LazySP was recomputed from its 300 genuinely raw per-episode shards, which match its episodes.csv exactly.
Each core/prior episode row is a single run at bmax=1000; budget-100/250/500/1000 columns are cuts on the 'assays' column of the same row, not separate runs.

The 1,100 prior-follow-up episodes include two 'none'-prior control arms (200 episodes) whose recomputed counts are identical to the core q2c (78/100) and collective_shared (78/100) arms, so they are re-runs of core configurations rather than new problems.

The 2,500 episodes cover only 24 distinct endpoint pairs (20 family-A pairs x 1 seed-set, plus 4 family-B pairs x 20 seeds per policy). The project states this itself; it is not 2,500 independent biological problems.
The LazySP advantage is not broad: on the 20 family-A pairs LazySP and q2c resolve the same 16 and abstain on the same 4, and 17 of the 18 LazySP-only resolutions are the single pair VFVS->ALKG.

Zero false certificates is a check against the project's own full-data ground truth recorded in the episode rows ('correct', 'verified_by_full_data'); it was not re-derived from the source landscape, which is absent.
